purpose: Bounded eight-pair follow-up pilot plan; no automatic replacement candidates are authorized.

candidates.placement_rationale: The target is visible before generation and the mask stays around one hanging object without covering the cook.

candidates.placement_rationale: A large replacement class requires a scene-scale target; the registered region contains the stove/cabinet unit and excludes the foreground fruit bowl.

candidates.target_description: a framed botanical print to insert on the empty upper-left wall

candidates.target_description: a small red cherry tomato to insert on the bread slice
candidates.placement_rationale: The bread provides a visible horizontal support surface and the small mask avoids the surrounding lunch compartments.

candidates.target_description: the forested rocky headland projecting into the sea at center-right
candidates.placement_rationale: The existing landform is fully identified before removal; adjacent sea and horizon provide the intended infill context.
candidates.prompt: open sea and distant coastline continuing naturally through the removed headland, photorealistic sunset landscape

candidates.target_description: a brown leather travel suitcase to insert on the cobblestones beside the car
candidates.placement_rationale: The lower-left cobblestone area is a visible ground plane beside the vehicle and does not cover the front wheel assembly.
candidates.prompt: a brown leather travel suitcase standing on the cobblestones beside the vintage car, realistic scale and daylight shadows

candidates.target_description: a small dark bird to insert in the open cloudy sky at upper-right
candidates.placement_rationale: The sky region is visually unobstructed and supports a small airborne object without altering the monument text or sculpture.
candidates.prompt: a small dark bird flying in the cloudy sky, distant scale and natural daylight

candidates.target_description: the bronze child figure held across the adult figure's arms
candidates.placement_rationale: The child figure is visibly bounded before generation; the large registered region covers it and its contact with the adult's arms.
candidates.prompt: a bronze bouquet of flowers held naturally in the figure's arms, matching the sculpture material, patina, and daylight
